seasons.name: Season X (10.40)
seasons.description: ' Out of Time ' - Season X brought back fan-favorite locations, introduced Rift Zones, and featured the return of many classic skins. The Battle Pass featured Tilted Teknique, Catalyst, and more.

seasons.name: Chapter 2 Season 4 (14.60)
seasons.description: ' Nexus War ' - Chapter 2 Season 4 was the Marvel-themed season, bringing heroes like Iron Man, Thor, Wolverine, and She-Hulk to the island, along with the Quinjet patrol, Stark Industries, and the final showdown with Galactus.
